result.stdout:
Description:
  Work item commands

Usage:
  quill wi [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information

Commands:
  push <file-path>                 Push a local markdown file to Azure DevOps
  pull <work-item-id> <file-path>  Pull a work item from Azure DevOps to a local markdown file
  view <id>                        Print a work item to stdout without writing to a file
  create <file-path>               Create a new work item on Azure DevOps from a markdown file
  create-task <parent-id> <title>  Create a new task as a child of a PBI or Bug
  tree <id>                        Print the hierarchy under a work item as nested JSON
  search <query>                   Search work items via WIQL and print matches as a JSON array
  comments <id>                    Print the comment thread on a work item as JSON, newest first
  list                             List work items assigned to me (or another assignee) and print matches as a JSON array

result.stdout:
Description:
  Search work items via WIQL and print matches as a JSON array

Usage:
  quill wi search [<query>] [options]

Arguments:
  <query>  Optional free text, matched against the work item title via WIQL CONTAINS WORDS.

Options:
  --assignee <assignee>  Assignee filter. Accepts @me or a display name.
  --state <state>        State filter. Repeat to OR multiple values.
  --type <type>          Work item type filter. Repeat to OR multiple values.
  --limit <limit>        Maximum number of results. Default: 50. [default: 50]
  -?, -h, --help         Show help and usage information

result.stdout:
Description:
  List Azure DevOps pull requests and print matches as a JSON array

Usage:
  quill pr list [options]

Options:
  --reviewer <reviewer>            Reviewer filter. Only @me is accepted in this release.
  --author <author>                Author filter. Only @me is accepted in this release.
  --state <state>                  State filter. One of: active, completed, abandoned, all. Default: active. [default: active]
  --repo <repo>                    Filter to a single repository by display name.
  --source-branch <source-branch>  Source branch filter. Short name or full ref. Matches exactly.
  --target-branch <target-branch>  Target branch filter. Short name or full ref. Matches exactly.
  --limit <limit>                  Maximum number of results. Default: 50. [default: 50]
  --skip <skip>                    Skip this many results. Use with --limit to page.
  -?, -h, --help                   Show help and usage information

Description:
  Print a pull request's review threads as JSON, newest first

Usage:
  quill pr threads <id> [options]

Arguments:
  <id>  The Azure DevOps pull request ID whose threads to read

Options:
  --status <status>  Filter by thread status (repeat to OR). Accepts active, fixed, wontFix, closed, pending, byDesign. Omit to return all.
  --limit <limit>    Return only the N most recent threads (must be >= 1). Omit to return all threads.
  -?, -h, --help     Show help and usage information
